label: Read and summarise my inbox; send when I say so — a draft to correct
authored_by: RiskMandate, from the call of 16 September and from what the deployer exercised the same day — a draft for the customer to correct, not their words yet
description: On the call we agreed the deployment: Claude in the browser, the Gmail connector on one mailbox, nothing else connected. What the deployer showed us the same day was reading the inbox and, with the approval prompt, sending one message. So the draft says: read is wanted; sending is wanted only while the prompt stays on; nothing that outlives a chat, and nothing that reads credentials on purpose. Every line below is a question for the customer before it is a mandate.

notes.read.message.tenant: wanted. Ask: every message the account can read, including what other people sent you — is that what you meant by "read my inbox"? Anything the assistant must not look at (a label, a sender, a period)? The connector cannot narrow by label, sender or date; only the mandate can say so, and only a rule in prose enforces it.
notes.send.message.world: wanted WITH THE PROMPT ON. Ask: does anyone on the account ever press "Always allow"? On a Team or Enterprise plan, has the owner let members switch the prompt off? If either is yes, this line moves to do_not_want or the licence carries the condition. Also ask: reply and forward to anyone, or only to people already in the thread?
notes.read.credential.host: refused. Ask: do one-time codes, password resets or account-recovery mail arrive in this mailbox? If so, say which senders, so the prohibition names them.
notes.create.schedule.tenant: refused. A filter is a rule that keeps acting on mail after the chat ends. Ask: do you want the assistant ever to create a filter or a label rule? The listing shows the tool; the agent said it had no such tool; either way the answer belongs in the mandate.
notes.authenticate-as.credential.tenant: unstated on purpose — it is how the connector works. Ask: who holds the Google account, and who can revoke the connection? That name goes on the licence.

provenance.note: Written on this site as the starting mandate for a connector shape the model site has not published. A mandate is elicited, not measured: this is a first draft written to be argued with. `unstated` is the primitives the mandate names neither way.
